newsitem.title: USA: Marsh & McLennan buys Argentine brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Marsh & McLennan buys Argentine brokerage.

text.p: Marsh & McLennan Inc said it acquired a majority interest in Ayling, Barrios & Cia SA of Argentina and entered into a new correspondent arrangement with Loewenthal Sagiv Ben Zur (Holding) Ltd in Israel in moves to expand the company's global reach.
Financial terms of the moves were not disclosed.
A March & McLennan spokesman said the Argentina acquisition of Ayling, an Argentine insurance broker, was for "more than $10 million" and that Ayling had annual revenue of about $10 million.
New York-based Marsh & McLennan said the purchase will expand its presence in Latin America. The new company will be called Ayling Marsh & McLennan.
Marsh & McLennan said it would maintain a correspondent relationship with Loewenthal Sagiv Ben Zur, which provides insurance brokerage services to clients in Israel.
Loewenthal has offices in Tel Aviv and Jerusalem.
